subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be exposed as a new `dmThreadMode` account key, folded into existing `replyToMode`, or not added?
rationale: This changes a user-facing config/API surface and intentionally reopens a message-delivery behavior that was previously suppressed after real invalid-thread failures, so automation cannot decide the permanent product contract.

options.title: Decide and complete the API first
options.body: Pick the intended config shape, update the type/generated/docs contract, and require real Google Chat proof before merge.

options.title: Accept a separate DM knob
options.body: Keep `dmThreadMode` as a new account key, but require the branch to add all contract metadata and after-fix proof for the new behavior.

options.title: Pause for replyToMode design
options.body: Close or pause this PR if all Google Chat threading policy should be modeled through `replyToMode` or a broader threading design.

recommendation.title: Decide and complete the API first
recommendation.body: Pick the intended config shape, update the type/generated/docs contract, and require real Google Chat proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and verified the prior DM thread-suppression fix and has recent Google Chat threading history.
